create_get_posemb: create positional embeddings using get_posemb with kind, pos_dims, and width parameters
build_posemb_sincos_1d: build 1D sinusoidal positional embeddings with posemb_sincos_1d for sequence length and embedding width
build_posemb_sincos_2d: build 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings with posemb_sincos_2d for height, width, and embedding dimensions
build_AddPositionEmbs: build a Flax module with AddPositionEmbs to add learned or fixed positional embeddings to input tensors
create_sinusoidal_init: create a 1D sinusoidal position embedding initializer with sinusoidal_init for max length and frequency scales
